title: UPS & NUT
description: The homelab UPS (Ubiquiti UPS Tower) through isa's NUT server, and whether every NUT client will shut down.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: On battery: the early hosts (labk3s, Ceph, the blades, the NUC) power off after 60 s. Battery low: isa sets FSD, jumphost and timepi go, isa goes last. No data: ups-metrics on isa isn't reporting (see Metrics age).

targets.expr: max(ups_status{ups="ups", flag="OB"}) + max(ups_status{ups="ups", flag="LB"}) + 2 * max(ups_status{ups="ups", flag="FSD"})

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: battery.charge. It recharges to 100 % within hours after an outage.

panels.title: Runtime left
panels.description: battery.runtime, the UPS's estimate at the current load. The ups-runtime-low alert pages under 10 minutes on battery.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: ups.load, percent of 600 W nominal. More load, less runtime.

panels.title: Mains
panels.description: input.voltage. Outside 230 V ±10 % the UPS regulates or switches to battery.

panels.title: Primary (isa)
panels.description: isa's upsmon, the only one that sets FSD on low battery. Stopped: on low battery the secondaries still go after HOSTSYNC, but isa itself doesn't. Logged in is the Buckle check nut-server/primary.

panels.title: Clients missing
panels.description: NUT clients (and isa's primary) that reported in the last 7 days but aren't logged in to upsd now. The Clients table says which.

panels.title: Metrics age
panels.description: Since ups-metrics on isa last read the UPS through upsd (every 30 s). Over 300 s: the alert ups-metrics-stale; every panel above is out of date.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Every NUT client that reported in the last 7 days (nut-client-metrics, every 30 s). upsmon stopped or UPS not reachable: that host won't shut down on a power loss. Last report old and the rest '-': the host or its Alloy is down. Early hosts power off that long after the UPS goes on battery (ONLINE cancels it); late hosts on FSD, which isa sets on low battery. isa is the primary, not listed here.

panels.title: upsmon logins at upsd
panels.description: `upsc -c ups@localhost` on isa: one login per running upsmon, isa's primary included. Below the dashed line: a host that is up isn't logged in. Both drop together: a host is down.

panels.title: UPS status flags
panels.description: ups.status as isa's upsd serves it (FSD is upsd's own flag). OL on mains, OB on battery, LB battery low, FSD forced shutdown, CHRG/DISCHRG charging, RB replace battery. A gap in every row: ups-metrics wasn't reporting.

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Charge and the UPS's runtime estimate. Runtime moves with the load even on mains.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: ups.load (percent of 600 W) and ups.realpower.

panels.title: Mains
panels.description: input.voltage, output.voltage and input.frequency. Input dropping to 0 with output holding: the UPS is on battery.

panels.title: Battery voltage and temperature
panels.description: battery.voltage (12 V lead-acid: ~13.5 V floating on mains) and ups.temperature.

panels.title: Client state
panels.description: Each client's upsmon and its read of the UPS through svc:nut. A gap: the host wrote nothing (down, or its Alloy is).

panels.title: Round trip to upsd
panels.description: How long `upsc ups@nut.sphinx-map.ts.net ups.status` takes from each client: the tailnet path to isa plus upsd.

panels.title: upsmon and upsd problems (logs)
panels.description: Lines from nut-monitor (every client and isa) and nut-server (isa) that say something went wrong: data stale, communications lost, poll failed, server disconnected. 'Data stale' on many hosts at once: isa's repeater lost the UPS Tower.

panels.title: Last self-test
panels.description: ups.test.date. The UPS tests itself weekly (ups.test.interval 604800); the date has no time, so this is since midnight UTC that day.

panels.title: Self-test result
panels.description: ups.test.result. Failed (or a warning) for 1h: the alert ups-replace-battery.

panels.title: Replace battery
panels.description: The UPS's RB flag.

panels.title: On battery in this range
panels.description: Time the UPS spent on battery in the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Battery voltage
panels.description: battery.voltage. On mains a healthy battery floats around 13.5 V.

panels.title: NUT logs
panels.description: upsmon on every client and isa, upsd and the driver on isa, ups-metrics and nut-client-metrics errors. upssched's shutdown lines come through nut-monitor.
